title: ‘The Traitors’ Season 6 Cast Revealed: Cody Simpson, Kristin Chenoweth, Whitney Leavitt & More
summary: A Lord of the Rings star and RuPaul's Drag Race alum are also headed to the castle.
contentText:
Kristin Chenoweth , Cody Simpson , Whitney Leavitt and more are headed to Ardross Castle, Peacock announced Friday (Sept. 18) with the cast reveal for season six of The Traitors .

The upcoming installment of mystery competition show revealed the news in a video theatrically narrated by host Alan Cumming. In addition to the Broadway legend, Australian pop singer and Secret Lives of Mormon Wives star, Taylor Hale of Big Brother , Gizelle Bryant of The Real Housewives of Potomac , Bianca Del Rio of RuPaul’s Drag Race , JaNa Craig of Love Island USA and actor Dominic Monaghan will be a part of the new cast.

Each season, The Traitors brings together a group of people for a game of deceit, separating the cast into faithfuls and traitors who must try to figure out who is who. Thursday night (Sept. 17), the franchise launched its first-ever season with only civilians in the cast.

The season six reveal comes just a few days after The Traitors won big at the 2026 Emmys, earning seven awards . At the Monday (Sept. 14) ceremony, Cumming took home his third consecutive statuette for host of a reality or reality competition program, while the show itself won outstanding reality competition program for the third year in a row.

The development also follows a jaw-dropping conclusion to season four of The Traitors , which saw traitor Rob Rausch sneakily keeping his identity as a traitor secret until the very end — making for a wild reveal when runner-up, faithful Maura Higgins , finally discovered the truth. The early 2026 installment also featured Lisa Rinna, Mark Ballas, Donna Kelce, Monét X Change, Eric Nam and others.
